text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Satsuki Sho, the first leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown. Having 
prevailed in the clash of the Big Three, 
Seiun Sky strikes a rare fist pump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there was no room for complacency 
in the upcoming Japanese Derby either. Her 
classmate and rival, Special Week, was 
fired up with her own dream of claiming 
the Derby title.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Seiun Sky receives a 
congratulatory call from her grandfather. 
Her success in the Classic class is also 
her grandfather's dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, without feeling pressured, she 
stayed true to herself. She headed toward 
the second leg of the Triple Crown, the 
Japanese Derby.
